system.description:
A Crystallized creature suffers the effects of their body and chakra network being slowly transfigured into crystal.

A Crystallized creature increases the base chakra cost of Jutsu they cast by +4, for each rank it has.

A creature with 3 or more ranks of Crystallization has its movement speed reduced by half, and they cannot gain bonuses to their speed for the duration of this condition.

A creature with 5 ranks of Crystallization are Petrified for the next hour. If a creature with 5 ranks of Crystallization take damage from a Jutsu based attack, they are treated as vulnerable to the triggering damage, instead of resistant. This condition then ends.

Creatures that are immune to being Petrified is immune to this condition.

A Crystallized creature can spend an Action, even if Petrified to make a DC 20 Constitution ability check to end this affliction. On a successful check, the condition ends.
system.summary: +4 base jutsu cost per rank; half speed at 3 ranks; Petrified for an hour at 5; DC 20 Constitution to end (even Petrified).

rules.text: At 3 or more ranks its speed is halved and it can't gain speed bonuses. At 5 ranks it is Petrified for the next hour; jutsu attack damage then makes it vulnerable to that damage instead of resistant, and this ends.
